sections.heading: A new adventure
bullets: Explore 1,500 dungeon rooms, fight regional enemies and take on bosses.
Clear rooms in order and claim your rewards to unlock the next room. New regions open as you progress.

sections.heading: Loot and crafting
bullets: Collect dungeon equipment, materials and essence from your adventures.
Use the Workbench to craft dungeon gear, and see all your owned materials in its dedicated inventory section.

sections.heading: Ready when you are
bullets: Compact room summaries show what lies ahead, with clear room and region locks.
Resume unfinished runs and collect unclaimed rewards after refreshing the game.
